title: EARLY STAGE DEMENTIA? British journalist, Yvonne Ridley, praises Hamas for the 'kind things' they did for the female Israeli hostages
text:
EARLY STAGE DEMENTIA? British journalist, Yvonne Ridley, praises Hamas for the ‘kind things’ they did for the female Israeli hostages February 13, 2025 by BareNakedIslam 6 Comments
‘Kind things’ as in giving the hostages Goodie Bags when they were released, containing mementos of their time spent in captivity being raped, starved, tortured and humiliated by Hamas terrorists. Heritage FL The goodie bags, reportedly handed to the hostages – Romi Gonen, Doron Steinbrecher, and Emily Damari – as they got into a Red Cross SUV in Gaza City, included unsettling items: a photo of Gaza, photographs of the hostages during their captivity, and a so-called “certificate of release.” Two of the hostages, held together in captivity, were allegedly coerced into posing for photos while smiling and holding their certificates. This grotesque ceremony, described as a “farewell” by Hamas, forced the hostages to simulate gratitude toward their captors, further compounding their psychological distress. ﻿
Filed Under: Say WHAT?
